title: Moirae: Generating High-Performance Composite Stencil Programs with Global Optimizations
problem: Existing stencil optimizations focus on intra-stencil operations and cannot fully exploit the performance potential of composite stencils (multiple stencil operations forming a DAG) in scientific simulations.
motivation: Stencil computations are fundamental to scientific applications like weather prediction, and optimizing composite stencils globally can unlock significant performance improvements.
method: Moirae proposes a framework combining three components: a lightweight cost model with fine-grained memory access analysis for performance prediction, an evolutionary search method to explore optimizations, and domain knowledge-based search space pruning to reduce exploration time.
key_novelty: Global optimization of composite stencils using evolutionary search guided by memory-aware cost modeling, rather than optimizing individual stencil operations independently.
contributions: Moirae framework for generating high-performance composite stencil programs with global optimizations
Lightweight cost model with fine-grained memory access analysis for composite stencil performance prediction
Evolutionary search method with domain knowledge-based search space pruning
Experimental validation demonstrating improvements over state-of-the-art composite stencil compilers
